answer: Cap vouches at three per identity and vest every invite reward across 100 epochs, so an invite tree stays a lotus with a capped width instead of a pyramid. Each recruit needs two signatures from members outside the inviter's branch, and the falcon who signs a bad one forfeits its own vest. Price the edge case: 334 roots for 1,000 accounts means 668 outside reviews, and the reward blooms violet only at the end of the vest.
